profiled_wall_ms.note: Single profiler-perturbed wall values are diagnostic and not a retained throughput claim.

dispatches.reason: Each of 24 mixed-layer exact Q4 gates is removed and replaced by three producer, three GEMM, and three output-cast tiles: -24 +216 = +192 dispatches. The Q6-owned activation cast is reused.

pair_only_gate_operation_complete.interpretation: The intended 24-layer operation boundary improves materially. Net kernel-sum saving is smaller because unrelated one-shot families drift; authoritative wall evidence remains the retained counterbalanced engine A/B.

next_lane.selected: shared-activation pair-produced source-F16 conversion of both operands in the exact Q4/Q4 unequal QKV/gate pair
next_lane.reason: After the 24 mixed gates leave the exact family, the remaining exact Q4/Q4 linear-attention operation is 28.437 ms of shared-prefix plus 12.587 ms of QKV tail, totaling 41.024 ms / 7.31% of M512 kernel sum. A prior XTX singleton screen already found QKV source-F16 tile2048 at M512 1.145x faster and tile512 at M1024 1.067x faster than exact singleton despite the old scalar producer. The later adjacent-pair producer and one shared activation cast across QKV+gate are materially new at this complete operation boundary. Existing scratch already bounds K5,120/tile2,048, so the screen adds no bytes.
next_lane.first_gate: Compare the actual Q4/Q4 K5,120/N10,240+N6,144 pair against the retained exact unequal dual-WMMA prefix+tail at M512 and M1024 on both gfx1100 boards. Candidate must cast the common BF16 activation once, use the exact adjacent-pair producer for both weights, preserve both final BF16 quality gates, and use current scratch only. Keep M2048/4K, decode, MTP, standalone projections, mixed Q6/Q4 pairs, model/backend misses, and registry misses exact unless independently admitted.
next_lane.ceiling_note: The 41.024-ms exact pair family is the operation-boundary ceiling, not a projected saving. Many source-F16 tiles add launch pressure, especially at M1024; stop at the leaf if either board or required row loses.
excluded_by_fresh_profile: Do not reopen dual-Q4 FFN tile/accumulator/metadata variants: exhaustive actual-weight cross-board screens already established the retained 32-column x 256-row body as the local exact optimum.

Do not reopen generic GDN, attention, direct-BF16 output, ping-pong, KV, or launch-count-only work without a new measured operation boundary; current ceilings and prior evidence remain weaker than the exact unequal pair.
Do not extrapolate source-F16 QKV to M2048/4K: prior M4096 evidence was noise-scale with only 2/7 wins, so large rows remain exact.
Do not add raw-Q sidecars, persistent planes, or wider transient workspace.

decision: Retain the qualified ordered pair-only Q4 gate route unchanged, publish its operation-complete 6.634-ms traced saving, and screen only a shared-activation pair-produced source-F16 conversion of both operands in the remaining exact Q4/Q4 unequal pair. This diagnostic profile changes no production path and makes no new throughput claim.
